observation.visible_scene: A person in a cream/white textured sweater stands at the left edge of a frame against a black backdrop with a gray wall on the right. On a wooden table sits a clear acrylic A-frame/trapezoid stand with a bolt pivot at its top; a bright blue flexible strip (labeled 'the Arm' by an on-screen caption in the early frames) is mounted on that pivot and rotates around it. A coiled transparent tube rests on the table base, connected to the stand. The camera is fixed; the stand, backdrop and tube do not change position.
visible_changes: The blue arm continuously sweeps around the pivot in a circular (clockwise) path, passing through up-left, up, up-right, right, down, and left orientations repeatedly across the segment.
The blue strip visibly bends/flexes as it moves, its shape changing between frames rather than staying rigid.

The person's hand grips the arm near the pivot during the first ~8 frames, then withdraws toward the lower-left and comes to rest at the left edge of the frame, after which the arm keeps rotating unheld.
The on-screen text 'the Arm' is present in the first six frames and absent thereafter.
The coiled tube, acrylic stand and background remain static throughout.
outside_clip_unknowns: What drives or sustains the arm's rotation (no contact, mechanism or airflow source is visible acting on it).
Whether the rotation began before the crop or continues after it; the segment ends mid-rotation.
The material and true shape of the blue arm (motion blur and flexing obscure it).
uncertain_details: Exact rotation direction and whether speed is constant or varying (sampling is sparse).
Whether the arm's curved appearance is real flexing or motion blur.
Whether the hand ever releases a push or simply lets go of a already-moving arm.
